items.q: What is the Weekly Wellbeing Community?
items.a: The Weekly Wellbeing Community is a calm weekly online group for mindfulness, stress reduction and community connection. It is a gentle, welcoming space to pause, breathe and reconnect alongside others. You are warmly invited to come as you are.
The group meets every Tuesday from 20:30 to 21:30. It takes place online via Teams, so you can join comfortably from wherever you are.
To join, simply get in touch through the contact page and I will send you the link. I would be glad to welcome you into the group.

items.q: What's the format, and is it free?
items.a: It is a relaxed weekly online session held in English via Teams, focused on mindfulness, stress reduction and connecting with others. For current details, including anything about joining, please get in touch via the contact page and I will happily share what you need to know.

items.q: Do I need any experience with mindfulness?
items.a: Not at all. No experience is needed, and the group is open to complete beginners as well as those who already have a practice. You are welcome exactly as you are.
